analyses.summary: Technical SEO audit identified 12 high-priority issues including slow page load times (4.2s), missing alt tags on 80% of images, and 15 broken internal links. Recommended image optimization and content improvements.
key_findings: No schema markup on product pages

analyses.summary: Analysis of Google Ads campaigns (Dec 2023). Current ROAS: 2.5 across $50K monthly spend. Top insight: competitor comparison keywords have 3.8 ROAS vs 1.9 for generic keywords. Recommended budget reallocation.
key_findings: Mobile conversion rate 40% lower than desktop

analyses.summary: Analyzed top 5 competitors. Key gap: no competitor offers real-time Slack/Teams notifications for attribution changes. Competitor A dominates SEO with 5x our organic traffic. Competitor B has aggressive retargeting but poor content.
key_findings: Competitor A: 50K organic traffic vs our 10K
No competitor has real-time alerts feature
Content quality: We rank #2 of 5 competitors
